cards.statement: When the Cursor stop script cannot run the verifier, loop_count 0 asks for an UNVERIFIED report and a later loop_count allows the stop.
cards.positive: A fake verify.sh that exits 2 makes the stop script print followup_message and exit 0.
cards.negative: loop_count 0 with a missing verify.sh or any other verifier exit prints followup_message containing UNVERIFIED. loop_count 1 or stop_hook_active true prints an empty object and exits 0.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Calling the script on stdin shows its contract and does not show that the native host ran the hook.
cards.rerun_when: The Cursor stop script, the host stop contract, or the spec-gates verify entrypoint changes.

cards.statement: The native Cursor agent CLI session in the 2026-11-01 fixture ended without a local stop-hook invocation.
cards.positive: A host-invoked stop hook would leave stop-invocations.jsonl in the fixture. This record has no such file.
cards.negative: The recorded session says the invocation log stayed empty while the agent finished.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Reading the record does not re-run the Cursor agent, and a stdin call of the script is not native dispatch.
cards.rerun_when: A newer Cursor agent build is tried, or the recorded experiment is replaced.

cards.statement: The kit ADR check accepts an added or modified numbered ADR and does not judge whether its rationale or approval is meaningful.
cards.positive: A numbered ADR whose body is only a title and TODO passes both the workflow and the starter.
cards.negative: A deleted ADR, the template, or a detected rename does not satisfy the presence check.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: The PASS line says content still needs review. Exit 0 does not judge the rationale.
cards.rerun_when: The adr-required workflow or its starter changes.

cards.statement: The test-evidence helper can accept a report that matches the declared schema even when no runner produced that report.
cards.positive: Hand-written expected and report files assess as VERIFIED when their identities and checks match.
cards.negative: An empty required-check set, a failed required check, or incomplete required cleanup does not assess as VERIFIED.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: VERIFIED does not open the evidence paths and does not show that a runner wrote the report.
cards.rerun_when: The evidence schema or ci/validate_test_evidence.py changes.

cards.statement: A green doc-hygiene result does not close an audit finding or establish release readiness.
cards.positive: A passing root-file step leaves a file that says a finding remains open unchanged.
cards.negative: The doc-hygiene workflow does not mention the fix plan, so it cannot close a finding recorded there.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Exit 0 does not establish release readiness or repair of the open finding.
cards.rerun_when: Release closure is claimed from a hygiene result, or the fix plan's closure rule changes.

cards.statement: Scenarios B5 through B8 had no recorded trial on 2026-11-02. A later file in research/benchmark_trials is allowed only when it names one scenario, one revision token, and an outcome of pass, fail, cancelled, or blocked.
cards.positive: The dated absence sentence remains, and a complete B5 record with outcome pass is accepted.
cards.negative: A missing revision, an outcome outside those four words, or a scenario prefix such as B50 is rejected.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Accepting a well-formed file does not show that a matched trial ran or that the written outcome is true.
cards.rerun_when: The trial checker, the absence sentence, or the B5 through B8 acceptance text changes.

cards.statement: Schema version 1 accepts a READY plan whose prose fields are non-empty and does not check that a method rationale is present or smallest.
cards.positive: A READY plan whose discovery is one sentence and which has no method field passes the AEP validator.
cards.negative: An empty discovery list fails the AEP validator.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: PASS says authority and results still require review. It does not show that a method was compared.
cards.rerun_when: The AEP schema or AI_RULES section 6.5 changes.

cards.statement: A non-doc change counts as documented only when the DOC DELTA section contains a non-placeholder value.
cards.positive: A section line with a real path or sentence prints DOC DELTA present and no warning.
cards.negative: An empty heading, the blank template, or a mention outside the section warns and still exits 0.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: A populated section can name files that were not actually updated.
cards.rerun_when: The doc-delta advisory workflow or starter section 7 changes.

cards.statement: A governance-waiver label still warns when the waiver section lacks a real value or an ISO expiration.
cards.positive: A section with Gate ID, Owner, a real ISO expiration, and a compensating control prints no warning.
cards.negative: The empty template, a placeholder date, or the same fields outside the section warn and still exit 0.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Non-empty fields and a real date do not prove the compensating control was performed.
cards.rerun_when: The waiver advisory workflow or starter section 6 changes.

cards.statement: Lychee at the version named in doc-hygiene rejects a missing local hub file and accepts this repo's hub files offline.
cards.positive: The hub paths named in the workflow pass with that lychee release and offline mode.
cards.negative: A hub file that links to a missing local file exits non-zero and reports that the file was not found.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Offline mode does not prove that remote URLs in those hubs still resolve. CI checks those URLs online.
cards.rerun_when: The doc-hygiene lychee version or hub arguments change.

cards.statement: The yq release named in doc-hygiene accepts this repo's manifest paths and usage links, and rejects a manifest-only checkout plus an outside link.
cards.positive: Manifest paths and bundled cross-refs both pass in this repository with that yq binary.
cards.negative: A checkout that contains only kit-manifest.yml fails the path step, and a usage link to NOT_IN_BUNDLE.md fails cross-ref.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: This card does not run lychee. Offline hub links are card doc-hygiene-lychee-hubs.
cards.rerun_when: The doc-hygiene yq pin, manifest path step, or bundled cross-ref step changes.

cards.statement: The manifest path step rejects a missing file or directory from the yq path list and fails closed when yq fails.
cards.positive: A directory prefix and a file that both exist pass for every bundle name the step checks.
cards.negative: A missing directory, a missing file, and a failing yq command all fail the step.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: This card's fixture supplies the path list. The real manifest read is card doc-hygiene-real-yq.
cards.rerun_when: The manifest explicit paths step changes.

cards.statement: The bundled cross-ref step rejects a usage link outside the selected bundle and fails closed when yq fails.
cards.positive: A usage link whose target sits under a directory prefix printed by yq passes.
cards.negative: An existing file outside that prefix fails, and a missing yq command fails the step.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: This card's fixture supplies yq's path list. The real manifest read is card doc-hygiene-real-yq. Offline lychee is card doc-hygiene-lychee-hubs.
cards.rerun_when: The bundled cross-ref step or its yq path queries change.

cards.statement: Doc hygiene rejects a missing root file, a Provenance banner outside the header, and a new usage document whose name is not on a hub page.
cards.positive: A header Provenance banner, the five root meta files, and a new usage document named on the README pass.
cards.negative: A missing root file, a banner past the first 500 bytes, and an unlinked new usage document fail.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: These steps do not run the bundled cross-ref check or the lychee link check.
cards.rerun_when: The doc-hygiene root-file, provenance, or anti-fragmentation step changes.

cards.statement: The spec-gates provable-enforcement fragment asks every gate class for a planted-violation canary, and its presence does not create those canaries for doc-hygiene, AEP, or ADR.
cards.positive: The fragment still says every gate class must plant a violation and require rejection.
cards.negative: Doc hygiene, the ADR workflow, the AEP workflow, and constitution files do not reference the fragment, so its presence fails nothing.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: The fragment file being present is not itself a planted violation of a kit gate.
cards.rerun_when: The fragment is promoted into kit constitution, or a kit gate starts referencing it.

cards.statement: The finding-set comparator rejects new identities in supplied reports and does not execute a scanner or authenticate those reports.
cards.positive: Two hand-written reports with the same finding identity and a check name that is not a program pass, and the files stay unchanged.
cards.negative: A new finding identity in the current report fails the comparison.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: no_new_findings does not show that a scanner ran or that the reports are authentic.
cards.rerun_when: ci/ratchet_findings.py or its adoption contract changes.

cards.statement: Kit doc-hygiene fails a pull request that changes constitution/ without an added or modified ci/claim_cards.json.
cards.positive: A diff that changes both constitution/ and ci/claim_cards.json passes, and an unrelated diff passes.
cards.negative: A constitution-only diff fails, and deleting the registry while constitution changes also fails.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Touching the registry file does not prove the new sentence received a meaningful card. A typo in constitution/ requires the same touch.
cards.rerun_when: The constitution-to-registry coupling step changes, or AI_ENFORCEMENT section 8 / AI_RULES architecture-ADR applicability changes.

cards.statement: An edit under constitution/ that adds a thesis and does not change the claim-card registry still passes this checker.
cards.positive: A registry that does not name constitution/NEW_RULE.md still validates.
cards.negative: A new thesis in that file does not fail the checker and is not copied into the card.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: A passing registry does not register the new sentence or show that it was read.
cards.rerun_when: The checker starts comparing constitution edits with card ids, or the promotion rule changes.
